calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') AS open_ended, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), max(valid_to) FILTER (WHERE valid_to < DATE '9999-12-31') AS max_closed_to
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS multi_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)=0)) AS z,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) AS all_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS no_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current <> (valid_to=DATE '9999-12-31')) AS flag_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to) AS overlaps,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from>valid_to) AS bad_range,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold') OR tier IS NULL) AS odd_tier,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date IS NULL OR member_id IS NULL) AS nulls
